summary: Strikers address a council as workers asking for protection, citing health and safety and long years on the job.
realLife: Casino strikers told a council that barriers pushed them into the street and a coworker was struck, and a worker said exhaust was aimed at picketers; they cited sixteen and twenty-three years of service.
sources: FOX 2 Detroit, striking casino workers ask city council for picket line safety: https://fox2detroit.com/news/striking-casino-workers-ask-detroit-city-council-for-picket-line-safety
inGame: a protest or strike from the public-action engine with its officials at the edge; the job record gives years of service

turns.summary: The striker asks for mercy instead of protection.
The council says it will support the request.

turns.writesBack: the silence is noted in the news
